title: Jiangcaoxiang alleviates hepatic fibrosis through the Nrf2/GPX4 signaling pathway: Elucidated via integrated network pharmacology, multi-omics profiling, and experimental validation.
authors: Huang, Xueqing; Xie, Jiaqi; Yin, Li; Zhou, Keli; Peng, Xiaoyu; Chen, Shiqi; Xu, Jiayue; Chen, Hongdao; Yin, Dehui; Ren, Shouzhong; Zhu, Ye
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过Nrf2/GPX4通路抗肝纤维化，虽含分子对接但核心为药理机制与湿实验验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: This study aimed to systematically elucidate the therapeutic effects and underlying molecular mechanisms of Jiangcaoxiang (JCX) formula against Hepatic fibrosis (HF) by integrating multi-omics, network pharmacology and both in vivo and in vitro experimental validation. METHODS: Potential bioactive compounds and their targets were predicted via network pharmacology and molecular docking. Key target genes were screened through transcriptomics, and untargeted metabolomics uncovered differential hepatic metabolites and metabolic pathways. In vivo, histopathological alterations in liver tissue were evaluated by hematoxylin-eosin (H&E) and Masson staining. Serum biochemical indices were quantified with assay kits, while ELISA measured serum levels of type III collagen, type IV collagen, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha. In vitro, Cell viability was assessed by CCK-8 assay. Intracellular ROS accumulation was detected by DCFH-DA fluorescence staining, and MDA levels were measured to evaluate lipid peroxidation. Finally, Western blotting and RT-qPCR were employed to assess the Nrf2/GPX4 signaling pathways. RESULTS: JCX improved liver function, reduced fibrotic deposition, restored antioxidant enzyme activity, and attenuated inflammatory responses in rats with HF. Bioinformatics analysis identified Nrf2, GPX4, NOX4, IL-17A, and HIF-1alpha as key targets of JCX. Multi-omics profiling showed that JCX significantly regulated glutathione metabolism, upregulated Nrf2 and GPX4 protein expression, and downregulated IL-17A and HIF-1alpha protein expression. In BRL-3A cells, JCX treatment reduced intracellular ROS levels in H(2)O(2)-treated cells and activated the Nrf2/GPX4 signaling pathway. The Nrf2 inhibitor ML385 markedly reversed the therapeutic effects of JCX both in vivo and in vitro. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrates the therapeutic potential of JCX for HF and elucidates its multi-target pharmacological mechanism, thereby providing a foundation for further investigation and clinical application.
abstract_zh: 背景：本研究旨在通过整合多组学、网络药理学及体内外实验验证，系统阐明姜草香（JCX）方剂对抗肝纤维化（Hepatic fibrosis, HF）的治疗效果及其潜在分子机制。方法：通过网络药理学和分子对接预测潜在生物活性化合物及其靶点。通过转录组学筛选关键靶基因，非靶向代谢组学揭示差异肝脏代谢物及代谢通路。体内实验中，采用苏木精-伊红（H&E）和Masson染色评估肝组织病理学变化；使用检测试剂盒量化血清生化指标，ELISA测定血清中III型胶原、IV型胶原、IL-1β和TNF-α水平。体外实验中，通过CCK-8法评估细胞活力；采用DCFH-DA荧光染色检测细胞内ROS积累，并测定MDA水平以评估脂质过氧化。最后，使用Western blotting和RT-qPCR评估Nrf2/GPX4信号通路。结果：JCX改善了HF大鼠的肝功能，减少了纤维化沉积，恢复了抗氧化酶活性，并减轻了炎症反应。生物信息学分析确定Nrf2、GPX4、NOX4、IL-17A和HIF-1α为JCX的关键靶点。多组学分析显示，JCX显著调节谷胱甘肽代谢，上调Nrf2和GPX4蛋白表达，下调IL-17A和HIF-1α蛋白表达。在BRL-3A细胞中，JCX处理降低了H(2)O(2)处理细胞内的ROS水平，并激活了Nrf2/GPX4信号通路。Nrf2抑制剂ML385在体内外均显著逆转了JCX的治疗效果。结论：本研究证明了JCX对HF的治疗潜力，并阐明了其多靶点药理机制，从而为进一步研究和临床应用提供了基础。
